answer: The pigment chain is verified at intake and canyon publishes each anchor. A newly minted alias has no such history, which means it must survive 12 epochs before its first payout, and abandoning it forfeits the wait. To earn at all, an identity must present a signature chain reaching back to a settlement at least 12 epochs old, anchored at a ocean checkpoint. Every extra alias adds 9 hours of verification and 18 percent more locked value. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
